title: Sumer over 12,000 years old, based on geodesy alignments

tellings.quote: think the ancient Sumerians are well over 12,000 years ago which is why they essentially invented everything

plain: A researcher named Matt told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2024 that Sumer, the ancient civilisation of southern Iraq, goes back well over 12,000 years, judging by how its sites line up with measurements of the Earth's shape and position, a field called geodesy. He says that great age is why the Sumerians seem to have invented almost everything, and if true it would push the start of civilisation back thousands of years.
